items.name: Mark
items.text: Enemy is marked. Cash In to gain bonus effects.

items.name: Cash In
items.text: If an enemy is marked, Remove it to gain a bonus effect.

items.name: Weak X
items.text: Enemies deal 25% less damage for the next X turns.

items.name: Vulnerable X
items.text: Takes 50% more damage for the next X turns.

items.name: Block
items.text: Absorbs incoming damage. Expires at your next round start.

items.name: Strength
items.text: Adds bonus damage to every hit.
Spin the machine again for extra chips.
items.name: Go Again
Repeat X
items.text: Repeat the previous text on the card X times.

items.name: Frail X
items.text: Gain 25% less Block from abilities for the next X turns.

items.name: Multistrike X
items.text: Increase instances of damage by X.

items.name: Rage X
items.text: The next attack deals X bonus damage.

items.name: Gift X
items.text: Give the player X random chips at the start of their next turn.

items.name: Absorb
items.text: Consume all chips left on abilities.

items.name: Bust
items.text: Counts all damage taken; at 21 it is stunned and loses its Strength.

items.name: Break
items.text: For every 30 health it loses, you gain a random Chip.

items.name: Loan
items.text: Offers you a choice of two loans: a reward now, a price later.

items.name: Earn
items.text: Add chips to your chip pool.
